action.command: cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U daz -d daz -c "SELECT id, name FROM kysely_migration ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12;" 2>&1; echo "=== Qdrant collections ==="; cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T backend node -e 'fetch("http://qdrant:6333/collections").then(r=>r.json()).then(j=>console.log(JSON.stringify(j.result))).catch(e=>console.log("ERR",e.message))'
